title: Ollama
description: Run any Ollama or HuggingFace GGUF model on serverless. Supports chat and completion requests, streaming, and automatic model caching on network volumes.

input.name: Model
input.description: Model to pull at startup. Any Ollama library model (e.g. 'llama3.2:3b') or HuggingFace GGUF repo with quant tag (e.g. 'hf.co/prism-ml/Bonsai-27B-gguf:Q1_0').
